Rat King.why: Strong crate/camp/hub fit, but his banner team-fight identity was cut back — Rule, Ratannia! DR 35->25% total (20->15% base + T3 15->10%), radius 24->20m, cooldown 130->160, charge 12->10s and no more Spirit-scaled move speed. Scrap Grenade 65->70 and Rat Swarm 28->24s keep the gun-bruiser core live, so this reads as a correction toward 50% rather than a burial — still A.
Rat King.notes:
10-05: banner ult gutted — CD 130->160, DR 20->15%, radius 24->20m, charge 12->10s, move speed no longer Spirit-scaled, ult talents stripped (T1 -20s CD, T2 +8s charge, T3 DR 15->10%: total DR 35->25%); base kit buffed (Scrap Grenade 65->70, Rat Swarm CD 28->24s, grenade bounce targeting fixed). Nerf targets the 61% WR outlier, so tier holds at A.

Day-0 kit read (2026-10-03), provisional — data check-in due 2026-10-09.
First-week 59.4% WR / 8.5% PR is novelty-inflated; the crate/camp/hub fit is the reason to start at A, not the raw WR. Raise if he holds >52% with a settled gun build; drop if swarm/vitality builds and spirit-burst counters dominate. A Tough Crate hotfix (on the meta watchlist) would cut his farm-route value.

Sinclair.why: Coin-flip kit-steal pick trimmed across the whole kit — lane (HP regen 2->1, bullet 17.76->16.5, falloff 25-61->20-60), utility (Rabbit Hex radius 6.5->6m / T3 +3->+2m) and ult (copy duration 12->9s, copied-kit CD 40%->60%) — so his already-thin win-condition leans entirely on stealing a strong enemy kit, with Vexing Bolt's objective damage halved.
Sinclair.notes:
10-05: broad trim — HP regen 2->1, gun falloff 25-61->20-60 (also on Spectral Assistant), bullet 17.76->16.5, Rabbit Hex radius 6.5->6m / T3 +3->+2m, Audience Participation copy 12->9s and copied-kit CD 40%->60%, Vexing Bolt halved vs objectives. Still C; the objective-damage cut removes his only structure pressure.

Changelog: 09-16 - no Sinclair line; divers that beat him gained from the tempo push, his winning matchups (Wraith, Paradox) shrink, and no spirit/duration item moved. Net flat.

Data disagrees with creators: no Echo Shard in the top-15 buys (30d, high rank); the build is duration/cooldown spirit.
